summary.headline: Review: verb + preposition pairs in her English-to-Arabic sentences, then sentences with tool words

rules.title: Each verb takes its own little word: e3zem 3ala, e6lub min, bet5aaf min, shakait min, shta2tili
bullets: learn the verb and its little word as one pair
only use 3ala with e3zem when it is 'invite TO'
complain about = min (3an works, min is safer)
miss someone = verb + li ending: shta2tili

examples.line: e3zemihom 3ala el-makaan el-taani - invite them to the other place
e6lubi min mudirek maktab a7san - ask your manager for a better office
heyye bet5aaf min kul el-7aywaanaat - she gets scared of all animals
min shu shakaitilo - what did you complain to him about
et6alla3 3ala awal email ili - look at my first email

rules.title: saarli + present verb = have been doing: conjugate the -li, never touch saar
bullets: the time often comes right after saarelna

examples.line: you conjugate the li, so sarli, sarlak, sarlna. But sar you don't touch
saarelna talat saa3aat benren 3alaik - we've been calling you for 3 hours
addaish sarlek bteb3atili rasaayel - how long have you been sending me messages
sarlo fatra byenze3ej minna - he has been annoyed with us for a while

rules.title: How often = kul addaish (every how much)
bullets: put the verb right after it

examples.line: kul addaish bterja3i 3ala el-madina - how often do you get back to the city

rules.title: Prefer A over B = benfaddel A 3ala B

examples.line: e7na benfaddel el-5areef 3ala el-shita - we prefer autumn over winter

rules.title: awal stays awal for a masculine noun; only the feminine is oola
bullets: my first email = awal email ili or emaili el-awwal
awal before the noun takes no el-

examples.line: only the female version is أولى. It stays أول for male
et6alla3 3ala awal email ili / emaili el-awwal

rules.title: Tool words with a verb: 8eir, nafs, a5eer, a8lab
bullets: his turn: she gives a verb + a tool word, he makes the sentence

examples.line: ana mit7ammes el-laila 5a66atna ishi 8eir - I'm excited, tonight our plans are something different
e7na ra7 nelte2i ma3/fi nafs el-7ada el-usboo3 el-jaay - we'll meet the same Sunday next week
a5uy dafa3 3anna 3ashana el-a5eer - my brother paid for our last dinner
deeri baalek 3ala a8lab el-tullaab - take care of most of the students
